Option Explicit
Option Base 0

Public Function CodegenFacts() As String
    Dim facts_json As String
    facts_json = ""
    facts_json = facts_json & "[{""handle"":""A"",""layer"":""Layer"",""object_name"":""Entity"",""properties"":{""value"":""data""}}]"
    CodegenFacts = facts_json
End Function
